title: fix(app-shell): a refused view save is said, and the Create View dialog closes only on a saved view (objectui#11578)
body:
Fixes #11578

Clause-②: no

`CreateViewDialog` is not exported from `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` (it names `ObjectView` and `ViewConfigPanel` from the views barrel, not the dialog), and neither of those two exported props types changes, so no published schema, type, input or accept set moves.

## What changed

Both doors that persist a new view now say a refused save, and the Create View dialog closes only on a save that succeeded.

- **Door 1, `ObjectDataPage.handleSaveAsView`** ("Save as view" on the object data page), and **door 2, `ObjectView.handleViewCreate`** (the view tab bar's add button, and the view-config panel's create mode): the `catch` keeps its `console.error`, and also raises `toast.error` with the lead `t('form.saveError')` and, as the description, the door's own message through `formatMetadataError(err)`. Each door now resolves `true` once the view is saved and `false` when the save was refused.
- **`CreateViewDialog.handleSubmit`** awaits `onCreate`. It closes on `true`. On `false` it stays open with the label, name and picks intact, and Create is enabled again. While the save is in flight Create is disabled, and a ref turns away a second press (button or Enter) in the same tick. A rejection is not caught by the dialog: it stays open and the error stays the caller's.

No other refusal path changes, and neither door's request body changes (objectui#11581 is left alone). The objectui#11576 chart payload is byte-for-byte as it landed.

## The shape I picked: resolve a boolean, not rethrow

The brief left the choice open (rethrow after the toast, or return a failure value) and asked for one shape for both doors. I picked **resolve `false`**:

- `handleViewCreate` also serves the view-config panel's create mode, whose `handleSave` calls `onCreate?.(flat)` without awaiting it. A rethrowing door would turn every refusal there into an unhandled rejection unless `ViewConfigPanel.tsx` changed too, and that file is outside this claim's file surface.
- With a boolean, the panel needs no change: it ignores the result, the toast now tells the user, and the panel stays open exactly as before (the door only closes it on success).
- Neither door swallows the error and reports success: `false` is the refusal, and the toast carries the message.
- `onCreate`'s type is now a boolean or a Promise of BOOLEAN (generic spelled out in words: GitHub strips tag-shaped fragments), so a caller returning `void` is a compile error rather than a dialog that silently never closes.

## The message

- **Lead:** `form.saveError` ("Failed to save"). It already exists in all ten packs and is the lead the console's other save-refusal toast uses (`useUserLocale`'s language save). No i18n key added, so `@object-ui/i18n` is untouched.
- **Description:** `formatMetadataError(err)` from `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, the one metadata-save error reader (objectui#11302). For a `422 INVALID_METADATA` it lists the field-anchored issues one per line; otherwise it is the refusal's message (`MetadataClient`'s `parseError` reads `error.message` off the ADR-0112 envelope). The reader's own doc asks callers to keep its newlines, so the toast passes `classNames.description: 'whitespace-pre-line'`. That is sonner's per-toast class slot, merged with `ConsoleToaster`'s, not a new notification surface.

## Pins

Three new files under `packages/app-shell/src/views/`:

- `ObjectDataPage.saveAsViewRefusal-11578.test.tsx`: door 1, with the real `ObjectDataPage`, the real dialog, and a real `MetadataClient` whose fetch answers the PUT. Two refusal classes (a `422 INVALID_METADATA` envelope with issues, and a `403` with a message only) each show one `toast.error` whose description carries the door's text, no success toast, the dialog still open with the typed label and name, Create enabled, and the page unmoved. A control case: a 2xx still lands on the new draft at `view/crm_deal.pipeline_board?preview=draft`.
- `ObjectView.createViewRefusal-11578.test.tsx`: door 2, the same four assertions through the real `ObjectView` and the tab bar's add button, plus its navigating control.
- `CreateViewDialog.saveRefusal-11578.test.tsx`: the dialog's contract. A `false` save stays open with the input intact and Create re-enabled; a `true` save closes it (control); while the save is in flight Create is disabled, and a second press (Enter) saves nothing.

Copy is not pinned: the assertions read the server's text arriving in the description, never the lead's wording.

## Measurements

The pins' direction was written into each file before the first run.

- **Pre-fix reproduction** (the three product files checked out at BASE `d0097af`, the pins at HEAD, restored by blob hash with `git diff HEAD` empty): `Tests 6 failed | 3 passed (9)`. The 3 green are the three controls. Doors: `expected "vi.fn()" to be called 1 times, but got 0 times` (no toast). Dialog: `expected 1 to be +0` (it closed) and `expected false to be true` (Create not disabled while in flight).
- **Ablation 1:** `const saved = await onCreate(payload);` became `const saved = onCreate(payload);`, through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `e13f6a2f54b9` to `d1f300de6f99`, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty). Result: `Tests 6 failed | 3 passed (9)`. Both doors' refused cases fail on `Unable to find an element by: [data-testid="create-view-dialog"]` (the toast still fires, the dialog has closed). The dialog's refused and in-flight cases fail too; all three controls stay green.
- **Ablation 2:** door 2's `toast.error(t('form.saveError'), {` became `void ({` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `2531454234be` to `1e3c6fcf38b9`, restored the same way). Result: `Tests 2 failed | 7 passed (9)`, exactly door 2's two refused cases (`got 0 times`). Door 1 and the dialog stay green as in-run controls.
- The subject reaches these pins through source (relative imports, and the root vitest config aliases `@object-ui/*` to `src`), so the ablations have no `dist/` leg.

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0. Both legs ran: `tsc --noEmit` over `src`, and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, whose `--listFiles` includes all three new pins.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/` (the whole package, not a narrowing): exit 0. `Test Files 985 passed | 1 skipped (986)`, `Tests 9807 passed | 9 skipped (9816)`.
- eslint on the six changed files (`--format json`, 6 files linted): 0 errors. The three product files' per-rule warning counts equal BASE's. The three new test files have 0 warnings. Type-aware linting is not enabled in `eslint.config.js` (no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`), so this diff cannot move a verdict on any untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- Exit 0 on every one of these: `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check-vi-mock-specifiers`, `check-vi-mock-inherit`, `check-vi-mock-override-shape`, `check-test-path-roots`, and `check-governed-queue-guard --test` (NOT GOVERNED).
- `check:changeset-claims` names two pending changesets that cite files this diff edits: `7070-no-invented-gantt-date-fields.md` (the gantt branch of `ObjectView.tsx`) and `app-shell-page-header-subtitle-4761.md` (the `PageHeader` call sites in `ObjectView.tsx` and `ObjectDataPage.tsx`). I re-read both paragraphs, and both are still true: this diff touches neither the gantt branch nor any `PageHeader` call.

Changeset: `.changeset/11578-view-save-refusal-said.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

## Acceptance notes

- **The edit path has the same silent shape, measured.** Brief hypothesis 4: `ObjectView.handleViewConfigSave` hands `persistRuntimeMetadata(...)` a `.catch` that only logs. A throwaway probe (the objectui#10210 wiring harness, its metadata client's `save` rejecting with a 403; not committed) read `toast.error` 0 calls, `toast.success` 0, and `console.error` first argument `[ViewConfigPanel] Failed to persist view config:`. The panel's half reads the same way from source (not mounted): `ViewConfigPanel.handleSave` clears `isDirty` and bumps `savedSignal` without awaiting, and Save is disabled while not dirty, so after a refusal the user cannot retry without another edit. Out of this card's scope; carried in the report for the seat.
- **View-config panel, create mode:** after this change a refusal there is said (same door), and the panel stays open as before. But `handleSave` still clears `isDirty` before the save settles. Create mode does not gate Save on `isDirty`, so a retry is possible. Noted only.
- **Docs:** the runtime-view-creation paragraph in `content/docs/guide/designing-app-navigation.md` describes the success path, which is unchanged. No doc edit.
